intro: Phase 11 — SDC Constraint Readiness golden suite (HR01..HR15). Expected statuses are derived from SDC semantics and the documented blocker/review/advisory mapping — NOT from validator output. Categorical statuses only (no numeric score). READY never means timing passes.

cases.note: Complete single-clock SDC with all standard sections. It uses options the validator does not value-analyze (group_path -name/-to, set_clock_gating_check -setup/-hold, set_clock_latency -source, set_ideal_network -no_propagate) → SCOPE-PARTIAL honestly fires → REVIEW_REQUIRED. This is the no-false-confidence behavior: a realistic clean SDC whose options are partially understood must not be claimed READY. Nothing blocks; no invented findings.
Same clean block with netlist: every port constrained or exempt (clk/scan). All collections resolve, coverage READY, design context VALIDATED → genuinely READY (no advisories needed).
din_b has structural data evidence but no set_input_delay → SDC-064 (warning) → REVIEW_REQUIRED.
data_in[7:0] bus; only data_in[3:0] constrained → SDC-066 PARTIALLY_CONSTRAINED → REVIEW_REQUIRED.
0 then 1 on same pin → SDC-049 (warning, DEFINITE contradiction) → BLOCKED.
set_max_delay 5 < set_min_delay 8 on identical endpoints → SDC-069 → BLOCKED.
One exact duplicate (SDC-067, info) → advisory, NOT a blocker. Overall must NOT be BLOCKED.
Silent override (SDC-068, info) → advisory. The later value may be intentional → not a blocker.
fp + mcp on same endpoints → SDC-070 POSSIBLE_CONFLICT (info, STA required) → REVIEW_REQUIRED, never BLOCKED.
foreach present → SCOPE-UNSUPPORTED → REVIEW_REQUIRED (analysis incomplete), not BLOCKED (no definite error).
Good SDC without netlist: DESIGN_CONTEXT = INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT + limited design verification, but NOT BLOCKED and NOT forced REVIEW by the missing netlist alone.
SDC-046 + SDC-049 + SDC-069 all present → BLOCKED with all three in blockers.

Realistic multi-clock block with legal repeated constraints (min/max, rise/fall, setup/hold, add_delay, virtual clocks). Legal multiples produce NO interaction findings (no SDC-067/068/069/070), and the split-command MCP hold fix suppresses SDC-021. But the file uses options the validator does not value-analyze (set_input_delay -rise/-fall/-add_delay, set_max_delay/-min_delay -from/-to, set_multicycle_path -from/-to, group_path, set_clock_gating_check, set_clock_latency -source) → SCOPE-PARTIAL honestly fires → REVIEW_REQUIRED. Never BLOCKED, never claimed READY without full understanding.
Undefined master clock (SDC-047) + max<min (SDC-069) → BLOCKED; fp/mcp overlap (SDC-070) separated as review item.
